job.name: Four ABI dependent checked-record CPAN matrix

limitations: The fixture carries a runtime bound Nat beside a proof-erased Fin payload and rejects every observed below value that is not strictly less than its sibling bound.
Ordinary Lean source and independently reviewed Binding IR are exercised through full and result-only CPAN APIs.
The independent Perl caller covers valid values, equality and zero-bound refusals, recovery, immutable inputs and a Nat wider than 128 bits.

Each route reproduces complete runtime and component distributions twice, removes author roots, installs without network access and replays after physical relocation across four Perl ABI configurations and two CPAN installation modes.
Complete CPAN distributions, receipts, reports, interpreter records, TAP, toolchain log, GitHub API records and a byte-exact split of the original artifact ZIP are retained.
The package floor is glibc 2.38; external Perl, C compiler, Lean and operating-system distributions remain trusted inputs represented by recorded identities rather than copied toolchains.
This lane establishes installed Perl acceptance only; aggregate support promotion and other host targets require separate evidence.
